summary: Proposal faithfully reproduces the paper's first observed 95% power-constrained upper limit on g_agamma from SPHEREx (Fig. 3 black curve). Identity, novelty, confidence, conventions (incl. documented 0.4->0.45 GeV/cm^3 density rescaling), numerical headline/feature agreement, highlight target, and visibility all check out.

result_identity.evidence: Paper title 'First constraints on ALPs with SPHEREx data'; AxionPhoton g_agamma [GeV^-1]; proposal uses the observed 95% PCL upper limit = black curve of Fig. 3 (p.7). Matches coupling_type and curve.

novelty.evidence: First ALP-DM search with SPHEREx (abstract, Sec.5 conclusions). is_new_limit=true, is_projection=false. Observed limit used, not the Cramer-Rao bound or 25-mo forecast (both correctly listed as alternatives, not proposed).

confidence_level.evidence: Sec.4 and Fig.3 caption: '95% power-constrained upper limit'; Sec.3.3 sets one-sided 95% via Delta chi^2=2.71. confidence_level=0.95 is measured, not default.

conventions.evidence: Mass eV, g GeV^-1 per Fig.3 axes. NFW rho_s=0.566, r_s=14.46 kpc (p.4) implies local rho~0.4; plotting method applies g*sqrt(0.4/0.45)=0.9428 to repo 0.45 standard (correct sign). Decay signal: polarization null is appropriate.

numerical_agreement.evidence: Headline 2.10e-11 at 0.606 eV -> data[0.606219]=2.10366e-11 (paper-native). Range 0.496-3.32 eV -> 0.49551-3.32278. He I 1.083um spike m~2.29 eV -> 5.194e-10 matches Fig.3 peak; 3.3um PAH m~0.75 -> 1.258e-10. Abstract median 4.16e-11 consistent.

highlight_target.evidence: Highlighted PNG shows a single red filled region at m~0.5-3.3 eV, g~2-8e-11 (fill up to y-top, black outline tracing the curve) = SPHEREx location; no unrelated limit accented; full view consistent.

visibility.evidence: Axis range covers m~0.5-3.3 eV and g~2-8e-11. Limit is competitive (tightest ~1.8-2e-11 dips below globular-cluster/CAST boundary), partially visible in full plot and clearly interpretable in the highlighted panel; label 'SPHEREx' set at curve start.
